commentary_title: Weak demand plagues Aframax tonne-miles to a new low

commentary_title: Tonnage oversupply in the Med hurts Aframax rates
commentary_summary: The Aframax tonne-miles index ended the week at 105.1 points down by close to 15 points. commentary_title: Aframax market remains weak but has scope for improvement
